messages:
incidents-bot: PAGENOTIFY CRITICAL → GPU mem pressure on serving-node-gp2-17. container=redbeat-ml-7 restarted 4x in 6m. symptom=OOM during prefill. estimated 3% request errors for route /v1/generate (model=redwood-13b-long). Auto-scaler attempted restart, now paused for investigation.

jay-oncall: I'm grabbing dmesg + container logs. marking node OF for isolation.

maria-cs: I'm on customer comms. Which customers hit this? any SLA impact visible?

kyle-sre: Early look shows very large prefill sequences (~100k tokens) from a single tenant (acct=acme-creative). Memory blowup during KV cache alloc. stack shows failure at allocate_kv_cache -> cudaMalloc -> out_of_memory.

lin-sre: Adding logs: ```
[2026-03-17T02:26:07Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (allocating 3.2GB)
[2026-03-17T02:26:07Z] model=redwood-13b-long prefill seq_len=102432 prefix_tokens=101000
[2026-03-17T02:26:07Z] container restart triggered (OOM)
```

jay-oncall: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) route /v1/generate for acct=acme-creative to redwood-7b-quant fallback for 30m 2) apply per-request max_context=32k for that tenant 3) add temporary KV-cache eviction threshold to avoid massive single-request allocation. Opinions?

kyle-sre: +1 to routing fallback. We can push route override with: `infra route override --tenant acme-creative --route /v1/generate --model redwood-7b-quant --ttl 1800` (will patch routing plane). Also throttling per-request: `policy set --tenant acme-creative --max_context 32768`

maria-cs: I'll draft message: "We're seeing larger-than-expected inputs causing GPU memory faults; traffic redirected to a lower-capacity model while we fix the root cause. No data lost; response quality may be lower for up to 30 minutes." Will post after you confirm the routing change. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ACTION_CREATED incident/INC-2026-042 - responders: jay-oncall, kyle-sre, lin-sre, maria-cs.

jay-oncall: Applied routing override. Confirmed new requests from acct=acme-creative now hit redwood-7b-quant. Error rate for /v1/generate dropped to baseline within 90s.

lin-sre: Deployed temporary eviction config to serving runtime: `runtime.set.kv_eviction_threshold=0.85` on pool gp2 to avoid huge single allocation. Monitoring memory and restart counts.

maria-cs: Customer update sent. Waiting for reply, will escalate to account exec if needed.

kyle-sre: Next steps for postmortem: 1) Add per-tenant max_context guard in the API layer (pre-validate) 2) Model-serving: fail fast on very large prefill requests instead of attempting massive allocations 3) Consider soft truncation or streaming prefill for long documents 4) Add automated routing fallback for tenants exceeding 75k tokens in a single request.

emma-support: Noting two support tickets opened by the tenant; forwarding them to maria.

jay-oncall: Handoff to night oncall @lin-sre at 1713340800. I will remain available for escalation.

lin-sre: Acknowledged. I'll keep watch on node restarts and eviction metrics. If restarts resume, will spin additional small nodes and move affected containers.

maria-cs: Customer replied: "Thanks, please keep us updated. We'll throttle our ingestion." Good sign.

kyle-sre: Logging quarantine: archived crash dump to s3://incidents/1713339999/gpu-crash-redbeat-ml-7.tgz. Savepoint for postmortem.

incidents-bot: Incident status → mitigated (routing fallback + eviction threshold) at 1713340600. Monitoring.

lin-sre: Closing notes: ticketing for follow-up created (TASK-3221) to add prefill checks + improved error surface for clients.

maria-cs: Preparing final customer summary for SLAs.

emma-support: will consolidate tickets and attach transcript.

jay-oncall: leaving channel. thanks all. :wave:
